entry.title: Crate Digger 2.0.0
entry.summary: # Crate Digger 2.0.0 A new look and a rebuilt plugin, with a new screen styled after a vintage MPC. ## What's new - **New screen** in three pages: PLAY, FILTERS and FIND. A green LCD shows what is playing, the status, the time and your filters; the five filter knobs sit directly under their own LCD columns; big keys and arrows are easy to hit. - **GAIN fader and a stereo level meter** on every page. - **PLAY and STOP lamps**, and SYNC now sits with the transport. - **FIND** is regrouped: DISCOGS

entry.title: Crate Digger 1.3.1
entry.summary: Dig for records by genre, style, decade and country on Discogs, then stream and play them into your MPC track. Needs a network connection. ## Requirements - A first-generation MPC OS standalone device (32-bit ARM, like the Force, MPC Live / Live II, One, X and Key 61). The installer refuses anything else. Newer models are untested. - **Root shell access** (SSH) to the device. Stock MPC OS doesn't offer this; you need a modded unit. - Tested on MPC OS with a Force. Installing plugins this way is
